canonical_name: Public Updates on Incident Recovery Not Shared Using Approved Methods
description: Public updates on incident recovery are not shared using approved methods.
applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations with business continuity and disaster recovery requirements Incident recovery and restoration teams Communications and public relations functions Organizations with regulatory recovery requirements

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Identify public-facing incidents where recovery communications bypass approved channels, lack pre-authorization, or use inconsistent messaging. Monitor for unauthorized social media posts, unapproved press releases, or communications that deviate from established crisis communication protocols.
